text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the orientation, 
inviting children for a tour around the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute was tasked with running in 
the exhibition race to give everyone a 
feel for real competition, but—

text_block_list.name: Observing Children
text_block_list.text:
Are you gonna run for us, miss? I've never 
seen someone race right in front of me 
before!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. In that case, I'd better put 
on a smashing run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute heads toward the track, 
though her clothes seem a bit loose on 
her.
choice_data_list:
...Does that racing attire fit you 
properly?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? Now that you mention it, they might 
be a little baggy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She responded nonchalantly, but I had a 
pretty good idea of what caused it—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—Which is why I'd like you to run in an 
exhibition race."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Sure, sure, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Now that that's decided, Trainer. We'll 
have to start getting your body in shape 
right away today~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This is an important event where children 
decide their future paths. I have to give 
it my all on the track.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Nn... Ngh, with this! 100 sets!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, that was a good sweat! Right, next 
is a 20 km swim in the pool—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Chicken tenderloin, broccoli, and boiled 
eggs! Accute-san, is that really all 
you're going to eat?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. High protein, low calorie. 
Nothing beats this for building up your 
body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had been conditioning her body for 
today. However, I never imagined she would 
cut down so much that her racing outfit 
wouldn't even fit...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry like that, ya know. Here, 
just watch—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Rustle rustle... Squeak!*)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: See? Now the waist fits perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"My body size changes pretty easily, you 
see. So I asked them to add a size 
adjustment feature to my outfit, ye know."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Races come with all kinds of conditions...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Differences in distance, racecourses—plus 
things like my own physical condition and 
how much I've grown.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wanted some flexibility with my racing 
outfit's fit so my body could adapt to 
each and every little thing like that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Have only one goal at a time. Don't waver, 
keep your eyes on that alone. And then—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hone both mind and body toward your goal. 
Sharp, to the absolute limit—that is what 
counts.
choice_data_list: Even if it's an exhibition race?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: If anything, maybe that's precisely why.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Because this 'orientation' might inspire 
some girls to make entering Tracen Academy 
their goal, might it not?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's why I wanna show them.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How should I approach my goals? I found an 
answer: by honing myself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't have to be the only right 
answer. If it could just serve as some 
kind of hint, then—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I'll just have to show them 
the absolute best run I can do, won't I?"
choice_data_list:
Both you and your outfit are so stoic when 
it comes to competition, huh.

Both you and your outfit are so stoic when 
it comes to competition, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I'll just have to show them 
the absolute best run I can do, won't I?"
choice_data_list:
Both you and your outfit are so stoic when 
it comes to competition, huh.

Both you and your outfit are so stoic when 
it comes to competition, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Aw, stop it, you don't have to praise me 
like that. I'm only doing what's natural.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, Wonder Acute's stomach let out 
a loud rumble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrroooowl~~)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oops. ...I hope the children didn't hear 
that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm not trying to teach you to push 
yourself too hard, after all. Keep it a 
secret that I'm hungry, alright? A secret.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how sincerely Wonder Acute cares 
for the children, I decided to treat her 
to plenty of delicious food once the event 
is over.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's just, I don't really know much about 
"fashion."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I left the design up to the stylist, and 
it turned out to be quite the trendy 
outfit.

text_block_list.name: Observing Children
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, big sis, run fast! Do your best, 
big siiiss!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, sorry to keep you waiting. Now 
then, keep your eyes glued on me."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I think if they watch, they'll understand 
the feelings we run with."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute confidently made her way to 
the track. I watched her dependable back 
as she walked away.
